name: XState Rulebook
description: Strict flat XState v5 machine validation, deterministic event simulation with transition coverage, and confirmation-gated game module generation.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Validate a flat FSM JSON spec and report invalid unsupported properties, reachability, dead ends and transition inventory.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Simulate 0-500 events and report accepted transitions, final state, visited states and transition coverage.

events.description: JSON string array of event names.

tools.name: testplan
tools.description: Generate shortest event sequences covering each reachable FSM transition, with unreachable edges and plan limits.

tools.name: emit
tools.description: Create a NEW, root-level genex-xstate-<slug>.generated.mjs module importing createMachine from XState v5; refuses overwrites and requires explicit consent.
tools.confirmation: Create a new generated XState module in the current game's root? The plugin refuses existing files and does not install dependencies.

slug.description: Lowercase slug of 1-40 letters, digits or hyphens.

skills.name: game-state-machines
skills.summary: Use this when gameplay behavior needs explicit states, event transitions and deterministic trace tests; read before calling XState Rulebook tools.
